# tenzir_deployment_types (Data Source)

The sizes and regions a deployment that Tenzir hosts can have in a workspace, and what each size costs. Needs `Workspace.listDeploymentTypes`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tenzir_deployment_types" "soc" {
  organization_id = data.tenzir_organization.acme.id
  workspace_id    = tenzir_workspace.soc.id
}

output "hosted_sizes" {
  value = [for t in data.tenzir_deployment_types.soc.types : t.size]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The ID or slug of the organization.
- `workspace_id` (String) The ID or slug of the workspace.

### Read-Only

- `availability` (String) Whether the organization can have hosted deployments: `available`, `requiresEnterprise` or `unavailable`.
- `default_size` (String) The size a deployment gets when none is given.
- `edition` (String) The organization's edition: `community`, `enterprise` or `sovereign`.
- `regions` (List of String) The cloud regions on offer, the default first.
- `types` (Attributes List) The sizes on offer, from smallest to largest. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--types))

<a id="nestedatt--types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `types`

Read-Only:

- `credits_per_hour` (String) What a running hour costs, as a decimal; null where usage has no price.
- `size` (String) The size, such as `small`.
